body:
CORRECTION TO MY DISPOSITION: the phrase smallest implementation slice I would authorize first was wrong if read as temporal permission. ADR 0007 already settles the temporal gate: Stage C implementation remains blocked until the existing real-transcript Stage 1b path answers one research question. Q5 must also produce the exact per-component licence/access table, with any terms accepted only by the owner. Today this topic may settle design and produce tracked successor scope; it does not authorize code, a new module, a dependency, a worker, or source access.

My intended claim is narrower: once those ratified gates close, the portable core/laws source substrate is the first coherent Stage C candidate, before evidence-consumer migrations and before any JVM adapter. The D1/D5/D6 AMEND disposition and cross-edition court otherwise stand.
